x_snc_airop_check_definition.ai_justification: Employee Center Pro is the delivery surface for Now Assist employee self-service AI capabilities. Without it, AI-powered knowledge search, HR case deflection, and virtual agent integrations cannot reach employees through the expected portal experience.
x_snc_airop_check_definition.remediation_guidance: Activate Employee Center Pro via the ServiceNow Store. Employee Center Pro is required for Now Assist AI-powered knowledge search, HR case deflection, and employee self-service experiences. If Employee Center is active but not Pro, upgrade to Employee Center Pro.

    var ecPro = new GlideRecord("sys_store_app");
    ecPro.addQuery("scope", "sn_hr_le");
    ecPro.setLimit(1);
    ecPro.query();
    if (ecPro.next()) {
        return { status: "ready", actualValue: "Employee Center Pro (sn_hr_le) is active", finding: "Employee Center Pro is active. AI-powered employee self-service experiences including Now Assist knowledge search and HR case deflection are available." };
    }
    var ec = new GlideRecord("sys_store_app");
    ec.addQuery("scope", "sn_hr_sp");
    ec.setLimit(1);
    ec.query();
    if (ec.next()) {
        return { status: "needs_attention", actualValue: "Employee Center (sn_hr_sp) is active but Employee Center Pro is not", finding: "Employee Center is active but Employee Center Pro is not. Now Assist AI features require Employee Center Pro for full AI-powered employee self-service capabilities." };
    }
    return { status: "not_ready", actualValue: "Neither Employee Center nor Employee Center Pro is active", finding: "Neither Employee Center nor Employee Center Pro is active. AI-powered employee self-service experiences are unavailable without Employee Center." };
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>PLATFORM</module><number>CHK0002691</number><order>550</order><remediation_guidance>Activate Employee Center Pro via the ServiceNow Store.
